rules.description: This workflow captures what the value of the First Bill Date is when Inbound Storage is first assigned to an Opportunity.

Corrects the issue of the system changing the Close Date (First Bill Date) to TODAY when the opportunity staged is changed to a closed stage. CloseDate formerly First Bill Date, Booked Date is now First Bill Date.
Case 02534948, record when field ‘Forecast’ was last modified
Case 02534948, adds date opportunity was first added to forecast

When an Opportunity moves to Stage 5 or the NCSP Status is set to "Sent to NCSP", this rule will fire so that the Booked Date will be updated to Today's Date. In addition, if the First Bill Date is in the past, it will also update to today's date.
rules.formula: AND( OR( RecordTypeId = "01280000000BDei", RecordTypeId = "01280000000BDeh", RecordTypeId = "01280000000BDec", RecordTypeId = "0122H000000URxX" ), OR( AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "5 - Signed/PO in"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "6 - Setup")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "7 - Closed")) ), AND( ISCHANGED(NCSP_Status__c), ISPICKVAL(NCSP_Status__c, "Sent to NCSP") ), AND( ISCHANGED(NCSP_Status__c), ISPICKVAL(NCSP_Status__c, "Escalated"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(NCSP_Status__c), ""), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Up-Sell/Lift") ) ) )

rules.description: This rule should always fire in case updates have been made elsewhere (such as the user record) so the field updates to emails are always current whenever changes have been made.

rules.formula: And( OR( ISNEW() , ISCHANGED(StageName) ), Ispickval( StageName, "0 - Pre-Qualification") )
And( OR( ISNEW() , ISCHANGED(StageName) ), Ispickval( StageName, "1 - Qualification") )
And( OR( ISNEW() , ISCHANGED(StageName) ), Ispickval( StageName, "2 - Solution Developed") )
And( OR( ISNEW() , ISCHANGED(StageName) ), Ispickval( StageName, "3 - Solution Agreed") )
And( OR( ISNEW() , ISCHANGED(StageName) ), Ispickval( StageName, "4 - Negotiate") )
And( OR( ISNEW() , ISCHANGED(StageName) ), Ispickval( StageName, "5 - Signed/PO in") )
And( OR( ISNEW() , ISCHANGED(StageName) ), Ispickval( StageName, "6 - Setup") )
And( OR( ISNEW() , ISCHANGED(StageName) ), Ispickval( StageName, "7 - Closed") )
